_buckets.runtime_graph: Observable, becomes nodes/relationships/properties in the Phase 4 Neo4j graph
_buckets.runtime_graph_filtered: Observable but only a row subset qualifies; see row_filter
_buckets.runtime_raw_evidence: Observable, high-volume; summarized into graph nodes, full detail stays in the CSV
_buckets.evaluation_only: Hidden ground truth, or re-materializes a gt_*/hidden fact under a different name; never loaded into the runtime graph
_buckets.deferred: Technically loadable but superseded by a richer table, or low enough value to defer; documented, not silently dropped
_buckets.excluded_redundant: Wide convenience file whose columns duplicate other already-classified files (including hidden ones); the loader never opens this file
_buckets.metadata: Docs / generator code / checksum manifests, not data

agent_cases.csv.reason: role/agent_id is a 1:1 restatement of gt_assigned_agent_id; superseded for graph purposes by phase3 assignment_history.csv

article_root_causes.csv.reason: KB article's own authored coverage of a root-cause family (population-level domain knowledge, not case-specific truth)

case_articles.csv.reason: Superseded by phase3 kb_interactions.csv, which is timestamped and interaction-typed; loading both would create conflicting/duplicate Case-KnowledgeArticle edges

case_components.csv.reason: relation=confirmed IS gt_component_id restated; relation=candidate is a distractor. Neither may become a Case->Component edge at load time (see CRITICAL FINDING in GRAPH_DATA_BOUNDARIES.md) -- Case-to-component linkage comes only from phase3 triage_history/diagnostic_hypotheses

case_observable.csv.reason: Sole source of Case node properties

case_products.csv.reason: relation=reported is product_reported_id (genuinely customer-stated, sometimes wrong); relation=confirmed IS gt_product_id and is excluded

case_required_skills.csv.reason: Already consumed as a known-at-assignment-time input by phase3's own assignment simulator; not a post-hoc judgment

case_symptoms.csv.reason: Customer-reported symptoms, genuinely observable at case creation

case_team_ownership.csv.reason: Restates gt_primary_team_id/gt_secondary_team_id ("the actual primary ... team"); superseded for graph purposes by phase3 routing_history/assignment_history

cases.csv.reason: Wide merge of case_observable.csv + case_ground_truth.csv; the loader must never open this file, use case_observable.csv instead

customer_cases.csv.reason: Customer-case link (redundant with case_observable.csv's customer_id column; used directly for clarity)

issue_subcategory_components.csv.reason: Population-level taxonomy association, not case-specific truth

issue_subcategory_teams.csv.reason: Population-level taxonomy association, not case-specific correct-routing truth

root_causes.csv.reason: Name catalog only (40 rows) -- harmless alone; case-specific linkage is governed separately, see GRAPH_DATA_BOUNDARIES.md

case_change_links.csv.reason: Observable proximity fact (time_proximity_hours, scope_match), no causal label

case_signals.csv.reason: Discrete, meaningful observed events -- kept as full nodes per spec guidance on signals (deduped via SignalType catalog)

case_telemetry.csv.reason: 206K raw metric samples -- summarized into TelemetryFinding nodes; raw readings stay retrievable from this CSV via the case_id:component_id:metric_code pointer

change_events.csv.reason: Observable change activity, no causal/distractor label

customer_entitlements.csv.reason: Commercial/SLA fact, no bearing on any hidden field

deployments.csv.reason: Deployment-specific detail merged onto the matching ChangeEvent node (extra :Deployment label, same id)

incident_cases.csv.row_filter: load the edge; drop the relationship column value
incident_cases.csv.reason: The case-incident time/region overlap is an observable fact; the relationship classification (directly_caused/coincidental_unrelated/...) is exactly the causal determination the future agent must infer itself (spec section on incidents) -- see GRAPH_DATA_BOUNDARIES.md

incidents.csv.reason: Incident node source, fully observable fields only

phase2_observable.csv.reason: Evidence-volume counts only (no relevance judgment) -- merged onto Case node properties

team_capacity_snapshots.csv.reason: Low-value static weekly snapshot; deferred to keep v1 scope controlled, not silently dropped -- easy follow-on if a capacity-aware routing query is later needed

assignment_history.csv.reason: Observable assignment sequence, incl. real reassignments

case_lifecycle_events.csv.reason: Canonical ordered timeline -- InvestigationEvent base label

case_outcomes_phase3.csv.reason: Purely mechanical counts/timings computed from the case's own generated timeline -- merged onto Case node properties

diagnostic_hypotheses.csv.reason: The investigation's own evolving beliefs -- the ONLY legitimate source of Case-to-component/root-cause linkage

hypothesis_evidence.csv.reason: Observable evidence-to-hypothesis link, incl. support_type -- itself an investigation judgment already legitimately known at that point in the timeline

ideal_investigation_requirements.csv.reason: The ideal envelope -- evaluation-only by definition

kb_interactions.csv.reason: Observable KB usage record; canonical source for Case-KnowledgeArticle edges

routing_history.csv.reason: Observable routing sequence, incl. real misroutes

triage_history.csv.reason: The initial (possibly wrong) guess -- legitimately known at t=0
